writer: Claude Agent SDK general-purpose agent, Claude Opus 5.5

map.name: Pellor's Cross
map.setting: a crossroads inn and its hamlet
map.trouble: The Ogre Lord Bludgor and his Ogres hold the old toll fort on Gallows Hill and no cart gets through the crossroads.

guard_bark.specifics: Ruddock keeps the north gate of Pellor's Cross while Bludgor's Ogres hold Gallows Hill.

first.speaker: Ruddock
first.text: I'm afraid old Tobbe has gone soft in the head. They've put me on the north gate since he took to wearing a soup pot on his head and saluting the crows.

again.speaker: Ruddock
again.text: Well, well! You look a good deal tougher than the last hero they sent us! Come by the gate for a mug of cider when you're done with the Ogres.

later.speaker: Ruddock
later.text: The Ogres of Gallows Hill were a filthy and greedy pack of brutes! The worst was their lord, Bludgor!

bounty_offer.specifics: Wila's bathhouse behind the inn is haunted by Ghosts and she pays to have them banished.

offer.speaker: Wila
offer.text: It is the most dreadful of hauntings! I heard them in my bathhouse behind the inn, moaning by the big tub in an old man's voice. Ghosts love to catch a man with his trousers off! Get rid of them and I'll make it worth your while.

reminder.speaker: Wila
reminder.text: I still have your reward put by.

completion.speaker: Wila
completion.text: Thank you! Here, this gold and these leather boots will be of use -- more than you'd guess.

journal.text: Banish the Ghosts in Wila's bathhouse.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Imps from the old well west of the inn stole old Tibbald's wooden leg while he dozed.

offer.speaker: Tibbald
offer.text: Bad news, plain and simple, lad. Once I'd dozed off in my chair the Imps came up out of the old well west of the inn and made off with my wooden leg, since they'll steal anything that isn't nailed down -- and now I can't get past my own front step! Will you bring it back to me?

refusal.speaker: Tibbald
refusal.text: Dobbin the carter was by this morning offering to whittle me a new leg. I suppose I'll sit and wait on him by the woodpile till winter, then.

reminder.speaker: Tibbald
reminder.text: I'm one leg short, I can't chase them.

completion.speaker: Tibbald
completion.text: Strap it on right here, below the knee. I haven't much to give, but at least I can walk you to the inn door now! The Imps -- they're gone? Please accept this as a token of my appreciation!

after.speaker: Tibbald
after.text:
Thanks once more for the leg! Pellor's Cross will talk of your daring deed for years and years!

Bless you, young sir!

rumour.specifics: Three folk of the hamlet: Moll on the Ogre Lord, Gimbo in her kitchen, Hask the wheelwright.

rumour1.speaker: Moll
rumour1.text: Bludgor would never have come down off his hills if Captain Vell had still been in town!

rumour2.speaker: Gimbo
rumour2.text: Hey! Don't you track mud through my kitchen!

rumour3.speaker: Hask
rumour3.text: I earn a fair living mending cart wheels.

shop_greeting.specifics: Fennick of the Four Roads Inn, Dagny the smith, Mother Quill the potion-seller.

inn.speaker: Fennick
inn.text: Pssst! Hey! You! Want a room? Lowest price for miles and the pies are baked by my own mother up at Hamley Farm!

arms.speaker: Dagny
arms.text: Ogres ate my pony. Buy a sword?

magic.speaker: Mother Quill
magic.text: I hear you're off after Bludgor. Good luck, stranger!

two_givers.specifics: Master Odric the wool merchant is wedged in his own window and needs Dagny's axle grease; Snig, a pedlar in the inn, wants an Ogre's tooth for his lucky charms.

offer_a.speaker: Master Odric
offer_a.text:
Who's that down there? Heh, heh, heh... I'm wedged in my own window and I can't budge...

Fetch the pot of axle grease from Dagny's smithy. She charges a fortune to any merchant of Pellor's Cross, but I will reward you well.

Once the grease is on the frame and you've got a firm hold of my boots, I'll slide right out of this cursed thing. Pull whenever you're ready.

offer_b.speaker: Snig
offer_b.text: My dear friend, a thousand thanks for sitting down with old Snig... Pull me one tooth out of an Ogre up on Gallows Hill. I promise you, nothing sells to caravan folk like a lucky Ogre's tooth, lad.

outcome_a.speaker: Master Odric
outcome_a.text: I never should have leaned out to watch those Ogres march by. I am most impressed with your quick thinking! How can I possibly repay such a kindness?! Wait here -- I'll fetch my old steel shield.

outcome_b.speaker: Snig
outcome_b.text:
Oh, thank you ever so much! Only one more tooth and my string of charms is full. Now slip out through the kitchen door before Fennick sees us dealing.

What's that? Pay?

Well, if gold is what you're after, please take this as a token of my thanks.

journal_a.text: Find Dagny's pot of axle grease.

journal_b.text: Bring Snig one big tooth from an Ogre of Gallows Hill.

rescue.specifics: The Ogres carried off Orlo, the inn's lute player, to sing at their supper in Stony Hollow, and his wife Brisa begs for him.

plea.speaker: Brisa
plea.text: Please... The Ogres dragged my Orlo off to sing at Bludgor's supper table! Their camp is in Stony Hollow, east of the crossroads, and the cookhouse door at the back should still be unlatched. Bring him home! Good luck!

reminder.speaker: Brisa
reminder.text: Oh, it's only you! No Orlo yet?

found.speaker: Orlo
found.text: Psst...in here, under the big kettle, stranger...

following.speaker: Orlo
following.text: Thank you. I wouldn't have lasted another night in that place.

completion.speaker: Brisa
completion.text: Orlo! My heartfelt thanks, kind sir! Here, take this purse. You should go see Mayor Tull -- his house is right across from the inn.

journal.text: Find the Ogre camp in Stony Hollow and free Orlo.

main_opening.specifics: Wuzzle the drunk points the player to Mayor Tull, who sends him against Bludgor in the old toll fort on Gallows Hill.

herald.speaker: Wuzzle
herald.text: Go on, Wanderer! Go flex your big hero muscles for Mayor Tull!

opening.speaker: Mayor Tull
opening.text:
Please... come in and shut the door! I know Captain Vell has sent us a worthy hero at last. The Ogre Lord Bludgor is still up in the old toll fort on Gallows Hill, north of the crossroads -- throw him out and open our roads again!

Welcome to Pellor's Cross! Take these potions. They may serve you well against his brutes.

reminder.speaker: Mayor Tull
reminder.text: Here, have another healing potion. Head north to the fort as soon as you're set to go.

journal.text: Win back the toll fort on Gallows Hill from Bludgor the Ogre Lord.
